digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate, evidence contract, attestation criteria
propositions: operator-attested evidence lacks deterministic validation of measurement provenance (environment, principal, privilege_posture, instrument), allowing claims measured under non-production conditions or broader privilege to pass as settlement facts

gates cannot re-run world measurements to verify claims without recursively applying the same privilege-masking problem; provenance must be forced into the record as text and validated against repo facts

plans asserting unchanged behavior across substrate/provider/route swaps while citing only configuration and no consumer of that configuration hide defects in uncited resolution paths, bypassing review

evidence from simulators or broad-privilege instruments cannot falsify the specific failure modes they claim to rule out, yet is recorded with equal confidence to observations that could have failed differently
